baseline.method: Unmodified author Pastis PM1 on all native350 loci and53883 positive contact pairs, with source ICE visibility correction; source NumPy2.4.6/SciPy1.17.1 backend

distance_definition: Euclidean distances for every unique pair among all343 input-supported loci; arbitrary translation and orthogonal transformations, including reflection, are unidentifiable and cancel exactly; no scale alignment
nrmse_definition: RMS error of all unique supported-locus pair distances divided by max-minus-min of reference pair distances
relative_poisson_excess_definition: (Poisson_negative_log_likelihood(prediction)-Poisson_negative_log_likelihood(reference))/max(1,abs(Poisson_negative_log_likelihood(reference))); positive53883 observed pairs only; alpha=-3,beta=1, and input-derived fixed ICE biases
reference_type: Validated standard-method result, not measured chromatin truth
tolerance_provenance: The pre-existing relative_poisson_excess boundary 1e-5 is retained unchanged. Removing near-exact pair-distance reproduction permits alternative solutions with equal or better public-contact likelihood. Historical reproduction metrics remain archived privately.
acceptance_definition: Only the physical positive-pair Poisson objective and exact unsupported padding are acceptance metrics. Pair distances to a particular nonconvex optimum are not an accuracy target.
